notMeasurements: fixture quality is not model benefit
stageCalls are future call opportunities, not observed provider usage
scope.requiredLiveLane: G2 confined role-specific local worker for every proposer, worker, composer, selector and reflector

authority.result: existing ares selection, number provenance and fresh final only
authority.fixtureReplay: data-only control replay; not a container Attempt, native probe, model run or adoption decision
authority.priorSeals: Existing #63 protocol, corpus, seals and baseline receipts stay unchanged.
roleRestrictions: Each role receives exactly its allowlisted DTO fields. Common v is 1; role is the named role, not a method/condition label.
library is an array of {sourceTaskId,text,sha256}; its bytes/hash remain identical for every role in a round. Conditions without library pin the empty array.
outputs/candidates contain only opaque {id,output} pairs. Selector has candidates, never guidance, method/origin labels, selectedSlot, expected, rubric or judgment.
Only current public taskId/prompt/data and outputs plus allowed prior completed learning-source DTO entries may be copied. No raw control file, paths or future-task info enters any role.
The outer data-only adapter replays prerecorded selectedSlot 0/1; frozen-base and retrieval-only have one candidate and no selector, hence slot 0.
Synthetic role inputs may be committed as boundary evidence; same-user private files and DTO validation do not establish OS isolation, live confinement or provider confidentiality.

budgets.appliesTo: one aggregate future live per-task ceiling shared by all roles/stages in each condition
budgets.unusedPolicy: Report actual unused allowance. Never force calls, tokens or waiting to consume a budget.
budgets.selectionControl: For frozen-base/retrieval-only, one output and no selector; use slot 0. For repeated-base and both contrastive arms, replay the registered selectedSlot (0 or 1).
budgets.executorModel: unavailable until separately authorized and pinned; equal across conditions
budgets.editorModel: unavailable until separately authorized and pinned; equal across editing conditions; disclose any advantage over executor
budgets.toolsetAndEnvironment: identical authorized data/tools/environment across live conditions; no public benchmark download or search
budgets.perConditionOrderStudy: separate study for each of five conditions and three orders
budgets.actualProviderUsage: unknown; no models invoked by the preregistration or data-only fixture replay

metrics.validOutputRate: valid outputs / full planned condition-task-order presentations, with executed and unavailable counts separate
metrics.correctness: private exact-string executable fixture checks; live judging independently blind after every compared output freezes
metrics.humanRubric: not measured; any subjective open-world tasks require a separate declared rubric and separate reporting
metrics.regressions: independently checked quality loss versus preregistered comparator; do not judge with the editor or role payload
metrics.selectedVersusBestGap: offline evaluator-only gap across frozen output slots; best slot never enters role DTOs or the prerecord selector
metrics.falseImprovementClaims: claims contradicted by independent checks or unsupported by unknown outcome/cost data
metrics.personReviewEffort: person minutes/decisions separately; fixture labels do not measure them
metrics.uncertainty: per-task paired distributions and all three declared orders; fixed small synthetic corpus is not statistical significance; task-order setting and model sampling seed are separate

guidance.rule: no regression increase AND (valid outcome gain OR cost reduction at no lower quality)

costs.accounting: Record every dimension per stage and end-to-end; subset timings annotate totals and are never added twice. No scalar sum across CPU/device/wall/person clocks, bytes, tokens or estimates.
costs.unknown: unknown is a literal unavailable measurement, never zero or an inferred model/provider estimate
costs.fixtureScope: No fixture replay quality, call-opportunity count or prerecorded output is a live benefit/cost measurement.

reporting.faultFixtures: separate structural/fault denominator; never add faults to task quality denominators
reporting.strictTransfer: Only registered learning-source tasks feed library entries. Freeze that completed authorized set for the entire held-out segment. All held-out reflections stay quarantined until every held-out output and judgment freezes, across all comparison arms.
reporting.learningStream: During learning, only completed preceding learningSourceIds in the registered order can supply prior entries; exclude the current and future tasks. Record an ordered source/hash stream.
reporting.roundFreeze: Pin one library content/membership/policy hash per target round; proposal, probe, composition, successor and reflection use the same prior snapshot.
reporting.policyRevocation: Invalidate the affected condition; never silently replace, remove, substitute or refresh library entries to rescue it.
reporting.fixtureReport: structural/fault pass or refusal only; all live conditions, metric improvements and cost-benefit conclusions unavailable/unknown
reporting.liveReport: publish full negative/unknown denominators, exact code/method/corpus/order/library/policy hashes, every cost stage, limits and source/fixture vs hosted CI vs native/live evidence
reporting.adoption: No T1/T2 adopt verdict or rollout. T4 may separately consider guidance and library experience only after authorized matched-budget live evidence.

stopConditions: Any authority/privacy/evaluator-access violation stops the affected condition and forbids benefit claims.
Changed code/method/corpus/order/policy/library bytes on resume refuse; retain the prior receipt rather than silently replacing it.
Denied or revoked policy/source invalidates the affected condition; record denied/unavailable and do not substitute data.
Unavailable G2 role lane, required producer or separate authorization marks the entire live comparison unavailable.
Judge-unavailable, unknown telemetry or sparse outcomes mean insufficient evidence; never convert them to success or zero cost.
Aggregate call/token/wall ceiling exhaustion stops the task; retain partial costs and failed/cancelled/unknown denominators.
No extra reruns after looking at outcomes; changing the declared stream requires a separately reviewed preregistration.
